title: cornus alba f. baileyi
intro: Cornus alba f. baileyi, commonly known as Bailey's Red Osier Dogwood, is a deciduous shrub belonging to the Cornaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant is said to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antipyretic effects, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cornus alba f. baileyi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
